scripts._comment_build: pagefind is intentionally NOT in the build. It was emitting a ~1.3MB search index into dist/pagefind/ on every deploy that nothing referenced — grep -rn pagefind src/ returns no hits and /blog/ has no search input. The dependency stays installed so re-enabling is one step: add `pagefind --site dist &&` back before build-llms-txt, and build the blog-search island (CLAUDE.md §2 sanctions it).
